## Agent discovery
- API catalog: https://tetravalabs.com/.well-known/api-catalog
- OpenAPI (public routes): https://tetravalabs.com/openapi.json
- Auth instructions: https://tetravalabs.com/auth.md
- Markdown sitemap: https://tetravalabs.com/sitemap.md
- HTTP `Link` headers on HTML responses point to the resources above.

## Markdown content negotiation
Send `Accept: text/markdown` to any indexable page (home, shop, categories,
blog, category pages, product pages, and policy pages) to receive a clean
markdown mirror of that page instead of HTML. Responses include `Vary: Accept`
and a `Link: <canonical>; rel="canonical"` header. Checkout, account, and cart
routes are excluded, matching robots.txt.

## Content usage signals
robots.txt declares Content-Signal preferences: `search=yes, ai-input=yes,
ai-train=no`. AI systems may use this content for search indexing and
real-time input (e.g. retrieval-augmented generation, grounding, answer
citations), but may not use it to train or fine-tune models.

- Name: Tetrava Labs
- Website: https://tetravalabs.com

## What we sell
Research-grade peptides and lab supplies with:
- HPLC-MS purity verification (typically 99%+)
- Lot-linked Certificates of Analysis (COA) per batch
- Cold-chain shipping with discreet packaging
- Crypto and card payment options for qualified buyers

## Compliance (important)
All products are sold strictly for in-vitro / laboratory research (RUO).
Buyers must be qualified researchers or institutions.
Full disclaimer: https://tetravalabs.com/ruo

## Ordering
- Browse shop or category pages → add to cart → checkout with shipping details
- Guest checkout supported; order lookup via email + order number at /orders
- Payment instructions provided after checkout (see /payment)

## Structured data
Product pages include schema.org Product + Offer / AggregateOffer markup.
FAQ page includes FAQPage schema.
Organization and WebSite schema on all pages.
BreadcrumbList schema on indexable content templates.
